title: Warm days, cold nights
text: In Gallup, July afternoons average close to 89 degrees, but January nights average about 14. The year brings only about 11 inches of rain and melted snow. Even so, about 34 inches of snow falls in a typical year. Averaged over the whole year, the temperature comes to about 50 degrees.
